summary: Gossamer Bio filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 disclosing a September 25 Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(1), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement; the matter is closed. The original deficiency notice came April 8, 2026 after 30 consecutive business days below $1.00. The company cured via a previously disclosed 1-for-80 reverse stock split effected September 10, 2026, with split-adjusted trading beginning September 11. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or consideration is involved. Watch for post-split liquidity and any renewed sub-$1 pressure as delisting risk markers.
